info.title: Avi CertJwtStore Object API
info.description:
Avi CertJwtStore object api
```
- show certjwtstore <key>
```

API permission: PERMISSION_EXEMPT

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: object name

parameters.name: refers_to
parameters.description: Filter to request all objects that refers to another Avi resource. Its syntax is refers_to=<obj_type>:<obj_uuid>. Eg. get all virtual services referring to pool p1 will be refers_to=pool:pool_p1_uuid

parameters.name: referred_by
parameters.description: Filter to request all objects that are referred by another Avi resource. Its syntax is referred_by=<obj_type>:<obj_uuid>. Eg. get all pools referred_by virtual service vs1 - referred_by=virtualservice:vs_vs1_uuid

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: List of fields to be returned for the resource. Some fields like name, URL, uuid etc. are always returned.

parameters.name: include_name
parameters.description: All the Avi REST reference URIs have a name suffix as URI#name. It is useful to get the referenced resource name without performing get on that object.

parameters.name: skip_default
parameters.description: Default values are not set.

parameters.name: join_subresources
parameters.description: It automatically returns additional dependent resources like runtime. Eg. join_subresources=runtime.

parameters.description: Avi Controller may send back CSRF token in the response cookies. The caller should update the request headers with this token else controller will reject requests.

_last_modified.description: UNIX time since epoch in microseconds. Units(MICROSECONDS).

jwt.description: JWT containing current portal certificate along with the full certificate bundle chain, signed by the private key of previous portal certificate. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

key.description: Private key. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

key_passphrase.description: Private key passphrase. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

kid.description: SHA256 thumbprint of the previous old portal certificate. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

last_rotated_at.description: Timestamp of certificate rotation. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

public_key_algorithm.description: Public key algorithm. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

type.description: Type of SSL certificate. Enum options - SSL_CERTIFICATE_TYPE_VIRTUALSERVICE, SSL_CERTIFICATE_TYPE_SYSTEM, SSL_CERTIFICATE_TYPE_CA, SSL_CERTIFICATE_TYPE_CLIENT, SSL_CERTIFICATE_TYPE_SECURE_CHANNEL. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

uuid.description: UUID of JWT. Field introduced in 32.1.1. Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

secs.description: Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.

usecs.description: Allowed with any value in Enterprise, Essentials, Basic, Enterprise with Cloud Services edition.
